REWRITE of two lost comments (my `rebar comment --body` calls stored the literal text "--body"; the
body arg is POSITIONAL). This ticket is closed — this restores its record for handoff.

(1) OPERATOR DECISION 2026-07-31: AC#5 (make the weekly result visible) was DROPPED, not deferred to
a follow-up. It would require editing .github/workflows/external-integration.yml, which story J11
(5200-e04e-246e-4aae) owns. The description was amended to strike it.

(2) AC#3 CONFIRMATION RUN — run 30651750699, workflow_dispatch on main at merged fix b7e6ac963.
VERDICT: this ticket's OWN defect is FIXED; the workflow is still red for two UNRELATED defects owned
by other epics.
  Evidence the fix worked: SnapshotRefError occurrences = 0 (was 40 on 2026-07-27); the
  "langfuse tracing round-trip" job, which previously failed on that error, PASSED; all remaining
  failures are assertions INSIDE the behaviour under test, i.e. the tier now reaches its subject.
  Remaining failures, both out of scope:
    - "jira DC harness smoke": tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_reconcile_pass.py:319 —
      "no local ticket was created from DC issue RBJNAZV-1; stdout='invariants: scanned=1 filed=0'".
      Filed as 0059-c7f0-cce1-4077 under epic e369 (since CLOSED by that session).
    - "external integration (live services)": test_execution_mode_live.py:44 (live_single_turn
      status 'failed') and test_workflow_live.py:127 (coverage.llm_ran is False).
      Filed as baa8-2c41-d9b9-4642 under epic 061c.
  AC#3 was then amended to the proven claim and the ticket closed `preexisting`.

(3) CORRECTION TO THIS TICKET'S OWN TEXT: the stated bisect window 2026-07-14 -> 07-20 contains ZERO
SnapshotRefError. Run 29723705918 (07-20) failed on an unrelated Jira link-direction assertion
(test_link_sync_roundtrip_live.py:423, 'blocks' != 'depends_on'), 1 failed / 27 passed. Occurrence
counts: 07-20 = 0, 07-27 = 40. The REAL window is 07-20 -> 07-27, and the cause was 2e2fe3f7d (72d9,
07-24) flipping the ROOT autouse default in tests/conftest.py:275-277 from REBAR_GATE_SOURCE=local to
attested + REBAR_GATE_REF=HEAD, against an external-tier fixture whose scratch repo never commits.
